argv: SELECT CASE WHEN c."file_id" IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE hex(CAST(c."file_id" AS TEXT)) END AS "file_id",CASE WHEN c."class_def_idx" IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE hex(CAST(c."class_def_idx" AS TEXT)) END AS "class_def_idx",CASE WHEN c."class_idx" IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE hex(CAST(c."class_idx" AS TEXT)) END AS "class_idx",CASE WHEN c."descriptor" IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE hex(CAST(c."descriptor" AS TEXT)) END AS "descriptor",CASE WHEN c."access_flags" IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE hex(CAST(c."access_flags" AS TEXT)) END AS "access_flags",CASE WHEN c."superclass_descriptor" IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE hex(CAST(c."superclass_descriptor" AS TEXT)) END AS "superclass_descriptor",CASE WHEN c."interface_count" IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE hex(CAST(c."interface_count" AS TEXT)) END AS "interface_count",CASE WHEN c."source_file" IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE hex(CAST(c."source_file" AS TEXT)) END AS "source_file" FROM classes AS c ORDER BY c.file_id,c.class_def_idx
